subject.title: Feature: configurable /new greeting model (or option to suppress greeting)

question: Which public reset-start policy should OpenClaw support for bare `/new` and `/reset` across chat handlers, the Gateway `agent` method, prompt text, and optional greeting model routing?
rationale: The request adds compatibility-sensitive config and model-routing surface while current main and v2026.6.11 intentionally ship acknowledgement-only bare resets and related reports ask to restore model turns, so automation should not choose the contract.

options.title: Define One Reset-Start Policy
options.body: Create a single typed policy that covers ack-only, startup-turn, prompt customization, optional model override, and bootstrap/current-time behavior, then update schemas, docs, and tests together.

options.title: Keep Ack-Only Default With Opt-In Greeting
options.body: Preserve the shipped cheap reset behavior and expose an explicit maintainer-approved mode for persona workflows that need a model greeting or cheaper greeting model.

options.title: Defer New Config
options.body: Keep current static acknowledgements and leave prompt/model customization to the linked reset-contract discussions until maintainers sponsor the config shape.

recommendation.title: Define One Reset-Start Policy
recommendation.body: Create a single typed policy that covers ack-only, startup-turn, prompt customization, optional model override, and bootstrap/current-time behavior, then update schemas, docs, and tests together.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied to the shipped acknowledgement branch, the fast Gateway reset behavior, and the current review history for this reset contract.
